title: 022. Valid Parentheses
prompt: Given a string `s` containing `'()[]{}'`, return `True` if every bracket is closed in the right order.
invariant: Every closing bracket matches stack.pop(); stack empty at end
steps: For `ch` in `s`: if `ch in pairs`, verify `stack` is non-empty and `stack.pop() == pairs[ch]`
Otherwise push `ch` onto `stack`; return `len(stack) == 0` at the end
